name: Morse.formIndex
why: Project: ⨆ over finite-dimensional negative definite subspaces of finrank (ℕ∞). Blind: ⨆ over all negative definite subspaces of (rank).toENat. Equal for every bilinear form on every real module: finite-dimensional subspaces contribute the same value, and an infinite-dimensional negative definite subspace contains linearly independent n-families for all n, whose spans are finite-dimensional negative definite subspaces of dimension n, so the project's supremum is ⊤ as well.
